triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: M1 is complete if npm --prefix packages/main run test:claim-admissibility-pack-framework passes after build and prints claim-admissibility pack framework smoke passed, while validate accepts the story evidence.
acceptanceBindings.note: Binds the single M1 acceptance claim to all registry contract, duplicate-rejection, compatibility export, and smoke coverage checklist intents.

note: M1 ProofStory contract: adapter-pack framework registry only; later Quantum verifier, gate policy, and benchmark milestones require separate stories.
